'''Grathal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Antiques dealer/Legends|antiques dealer]] operating in [[Arginall City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served as a middle-man in the meeting between an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] contact team and [[Ketrian Altronel]].<ref name="Firepower" />
